thread:
Sam Carter: noticing a steady spike in APAC tokenstore latency since ~07:02 UTC, started paging. paging history shows multiple 5xxs from streaming endpoints.
incident-bot: INC-4302 created by Sam Carter at 07:06 UTC — Severity: P2. Affected: streaming generate + chat endpoints in apac region. Pager sent to @Sam Carter (primary) and @Leo Zhang (secondary).
Sam Carter: quick summary: tokenstore p99 jumped from ~40ms -> ~1200ms, KV eviction counts rising. customer-facing error rate ~3.8% for apac customers (top-10 customers account for ~65% of that). No database restarts yet. rolling mitigations in progress.
Leo Zhang: on it, joining bridge. any recent deploys to apac tokenstore? @Maria Gomez
Maria Gomez: no deploys flagged in the last hour. Autoscale events: a few GPU recycles, but infra metrics look green for serving nodes. Tokenstore hosts showing CPU ~85% and elevated IO wait.
Sam Carter: immediate mitigations in play:
- Disabled prefetch for heavy regen routes (apac) to reduce write amplification. command used: `curl -XPOST \"https://console.redwood/api/v1/route-config/prefetch\" -d '{\"region\":\"apac\",\"prefetch\":false}'`
- Raised kv_cache_ttl from 60s -> 300s for read-heavy keys (policy id: ttl-aug-2026-apac)
- Activated fallback routing of 10% of traffic from apac -> eu-west for premium customers using `route-override` (see command below)

Josh Patel: command ran to route 10%: ```
./infra/route_override --region apac --target eu-west --percent 10 --comment \"mitigate tokenstore p99 spike\"
```
Maria Gomez: logs attached (snippet):
```
[07:03:12] tokenstore-3 apac: KV GET latency 1123ms key=\"user:regen:xyz\"
[07:03:15] tokenstore-2 apac: evict count +142 in 60s
[07:04:01] tokenstore-1 apac: IO wait spiked to 0.62
```
Sam Carter: customer impact assessment: a small set of high-volume customers seeing failed /regen and 5xx for streaming. Non-critical users mostly see higher latency only. No SLA breach yet but close to error budget for a few customers.
Leo Zhang: oncall checklist:
- Primary: Sam Carter (handling ops + customer comms)
- Secondary: Leo Zhang (bridge lead, infra mitigations)
- Backup: Maria Gomez (observability + logs)
- If escalates beyond P2 -> escalate to Eng SRE oncall (pagerduty group: #eng-sre-pager)

Sam Carter: can we temporarily increase connection timeout and retry policy for clients in apac so they can gracefully fallback to eu-west when routed? Maria, can you coordinate with SDK team?
Maria Gomez: pinged SDK rotation channel. Suggested change: client retry: 3 -> 5 with exponential backoff for apac region for 20m window. SDK lead acknowledged.
Josh Patel: quick A/B check: switched off prefetch for top regen route only (config id: prefetch-top10-0706). If we still see KV evictions >200/min we'll consider adding an extra tokenstore replica in apac (hot swap).
Sam Carter: timeline so far: 07:02 anomaly -> 07:06 INC created -> 07:10 prefetch disabled -> 07:14 route override 10% -> 07:22 KV TTL bump applied. Observed p99 reduced to ~450ms at 07:30 but still noisy.
incident-bot: Update: alerting suppressed for KV eviction once mitigation flag set by Sam Carter.
Leo Zhang: next actions for night shift handoff:
- Watch p99 and evict rate for next 2h. If p99 > 600ms for more than 10m, ramp route_override to 30% and contact regional infra to consider adding replica.
- If 5xx > 5% sustained -> open P1 and notify Eng SRE and Product Impact.
- Keep customer comms updated for affected top-10 customers (Sam)

Sam Carter: current runbook refs:
- Tokenstore mitigation: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tokenstore-eviction
- Routing fallback: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/route-override
- Customer comms template: https://internal.redwood/templates/incident-customer-update

Maria Gomez: dashboards to watch:
- /dash/infra/tokenstore/apac/latency
- /dash/traffic/routing/apac-euw-fallback
- /dash/observability/errors/streaming

Josh Patel: a couple reminders:
- don't do a full-scale config push for TTLs unless tested in shadow mode
- if adding replicas, coordinate with capacity team (capacity@redwood) for storage quotas

Sam Carter: handing off now to night shift. Key items for next oncall pair:
- Primary/Secondary swap: @Leo becomes primary at 07:45 UTC; @Sam remains reachable for customer comms until 08:30 UTC.
- Immediate thresholds: p99 > 600ms (10m sustained) -> ramp to 30% route_override; 5xx > 5% -> escalate to P1.
- Current mitigations in place: prefetch off (top routes), TTL bump, 10% routing to eu-west.
- Outstanding: decide on adding extra apac replica if evictions don't drop below 100/min.

Leo Zhang: acknowledged. I'll take prim when Sam signs off. I'll monitor p99, evict rate, and customer error buckets. @incident-bot please post reminder at 08:15 UTC for handoff status update.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled at 08:15 UTC for thread 1761123345.
Sam Carter: thanks team. Leaving bridge in stable/observing state. I'll post a short customer note in ~15m with affected customer list and mitigation summary. :thumbsup:
